title: Add targeted LDBC Query 14 stage profiler

steps.step: Continue from BENCHPROD-108 where non-isolation full test-data LDBC still timed out with Q14 enabled
Add a dedicated FusionDB-bench Q14 profiling harness using existing LDBC PostgreSQL test-data preload
Split Q14 into measurable stages: search_graph, paths, edges, unique_edges, weightedpaths
Run prefix40 profiler smoke to verify harness correctness
Run full test-data profiler to identify the active Q14 bottleneck
Record profiler evidence without claiming a full native LDBC pass

result.current_frontier: Q14 full test-data is no longer a black-box recursive CTE timeout. The recursive/path/edge stages are small and fast; the active bottleneck is weightedpaths message-pair scoring and aggregation.

remaining_blockers: BENCHPROD-109 is targeted diagnostic evidence, not a full official/native LDBC benchmark pass.
Full native LDBC remains blocked because weightedpaths times out in Q14 full test-data profiling.
Next optimization should focus on the unique_edges x message x message scoring joins and grouped aggregation.
The configured LDBC PostgreSQL implementation still logs missing update-query files in command-mode runs, so update coverage is not proven.
Native memtier remains blocked by missing real memtier_benchmark tooling.
next_task: BENCHPROD-110 candidate: optimize Q14 weightedpaths/message-pair scoring through join ordering, indexed creator/reply lookups, or a targeted semi-join/materialization path.
